meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 将 H&E 染色组织图像按 224x224 小块处理,预测指定基因的表达量(log1p-CPM),可按基因符号查询约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因,整张切片先分块再批量预测后拼成空间表达图。
howto.when: 当用户需要从 H&E 染色图像预测 224x224 约 20x 小块的空间基因表达(log1p-CPM)、按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或对整张切片分块后做预测时触发。

say.text: 用这张 H&E 图像,帮我预测 EPCAM 和 CD3D 的表达量。
say.note: 会输出每个 224×224 小块中这两个基因的表达值。

say.text: 把整张切片切成小块,预测这 10 个基因的表达,并拼成一张图。
say.note: 先分块再批量预测,返回整张切片的空间基因表达图。

say.text: 分别用 scgpt 和 evo2 两种基因编码,预测同一批切片的基因表达并对比。
say.note: 可比较不同基因嵌入对预测结果的影响。

howto.what_en: Turns H&E histology into virtual spatial transcriptomics: predicts expression (log1p-CPM) for user-selected genes per 224x224 tile, and assembles whole-slide results as a spatial expression map. Queryable gene symbols cover about 19k protein-coding genes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need spatial gene expression for 224x224 tiles at roughly 20x (log1p-CPM), want to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or ask for whole-slide prediction after tiling.

say_en.text: Use this H&E image to predict EPCAM and CD3D expression.
say_en.note: Returns expression values for each 224x224 tile.

say_en.text: Tile the whole slide, predict these 10 genes, and assemble a map.
say_en.note: Tiles first, then runs batched prediction to return a slide-level map.

say_en.text: Predict the same slide batch with scgpt and evo2 embeddings and compare.
say_en.note: Highlights differences between the two gene embedding sources.
